svg.title: SEBA microservices architecture
svg.desc: Microservices architecture for SEBA on Kubernetes: three independently versioned top-level Helm charts — voltha, seba-services, base-kubernetes — each encapsulating autonomous business capabilities, communicating via Kafka topics and REST endpoints.

g.text: Topics per service domain · no direct coupling between producers and consumers
Business-domain microservices · independently versioned · own config namespace each

g.text: Kubernetes cluster infrastructure · independently versioned · service discovery, scheduling, networking
